title: Fix working_directory root detection in run/cao_auto.py for wcao/tasks.json
detail: In run/cao_auto.py, replace hardcoded self.session_dir.parent.parent with a robust find_repo_root helper that searches upward for .git, pyproject.toml, or cao.config.toml. Ensure both working_directory in _dispatch_task and root_dir in _run_audit_gate resolve to the repo root regardless of whether tasks.json is in wcao/ or wcao/sessions/session_NNN/. Update tests in tests/test_auto.py.

title: Add multi-project scoped supervisor session names to cao-run and cao-stop
detail: In run/cao-run, replace hardcoded 'cao-supervisor' session name with a scoped session name 'cao-supervisor-<project_name>' (defaulting to directory basename or accepting --project <name>). Update tmux session collision checks and attach messages. In run/cao-stop, allow targeting specific project supervisor sessions or --all.

title: Add pythonpath configuration to pyproject.toml and sync task state
detail: In pyproject.toml, add pythonpath = ['.'] under [tool.pytest.ini_options] so pytest can be run without manual PYTHONPATH=. environment variable.

title: Build turn/token estimator and context compactor module (Hermes 50% rule)
detail: Implement run/cao_compactor.py with ContextCompactor class. Estimate tokens and turn counts. When estimated context exceeds 50% of the active model window, compact stdout logs and worker outputs into a structured state diff while preserving root goal, task DAG, and wcao/design/ contracts. Write unit tests in tests/test_compactor.py.

title: Wire compactor hook into cao-auto autonomous runner
detail: Hook ContextCompactor into AutonomousRunner execution loop in run/cao_auto.py. Trigger compaction and checkpoint updates to wcao/plans/now.md when turn counts or output thresholds are reached.

title: Build dynamic procedural memory manager (wcao/skills/)
detail: Create run/cao_skills.py with helper to record learned procedural skills into wcao/skills/<topic>.md. Update supervisor and coder prompt templates so agents check wcao/skills/*.md before executing tasks.

title: Implement SQLite FTS5 episodic memory layer and cao-memory CLI
detail: Create run/cao_memory.py backed by wcao/memory.sqlite using an FTS5 virtual table (session_id, category, summary, details, file_paths, created_at). Build CLI tool run/cao-memory with query/store subcommands. Add unit tests in tests/test_memory.py.

title: Integrate Nous Hermes CLI worker provider into CAO config and prompts
detail: Add hermes_cli to KNOWN_PROVIDERS in 3_apply/render_config.py. Add hermes detection in run/cao-doctor. Define hermes_worker in 2_configure/cao.config.toml and create prompt template 2_configure/prompts/hermes.md.

title: Implement HarnessRouter-inspired conformance and crash recovery tests
detail: Create tests/test_conformance.py testing worker crash recovery (ensuring dead worker PIDs do not deadlock cao-auto), mid-DAG 429 quota failover handling, and post-task artifact integrity validation.
